title: storage
description: Every present volume, the SnapRAID parity state, and the least-squares fill forecast.

forecast.description: Human sentence from pulse.forecast_gfull (e.g. 'G: full in ~3.4 years'). Empty string = unavailable; the UI must render nothing rather than invent a number.

state.description: 'synced' means a sync SUCCEEDED within 48h - proven by the sync log's own completion line, not by the existence of a file. The old flag-existence test reported 'protected' for 27 days on a stale 2026-07-03 migration marker.

sync_source.description: 'log' = a real completion record. 'flag' = only the legacy migration marker was found, which is a weaker claim and must be labelled as such in the UI. null = neither.
